description: Robinhood Chain developer activity timeline for one deployer: launches (tokens whose recorded deployer is this address; attribution creator = seen at launch, pool_creator = only the first pool's creator is known, weaker) and dev_buy / dev_sell of its OWN tokens by the address itself (ERC-4337 senders resolved), one event per trade leg, newest first, keyset paged (next_cursor; coverage.scan_truncated says where a bounded scan stopped, never a false end). event_id equals the rhc:dev_activity WS id. token_amount_raw is an exact uint256 string. Not included: developer token transfers, other wallets of the same person, history older than coverage.dev_trades_complete_from. Tier: PRO+.

since.description: ISO timestamp lower bound (default 30 days, at most 90)

types.description: Comma list of launch, dev_buy, dev_sell (default all)

name: rhc_deployer_activity
